Several days (many hours: 300 kills, five bosses and lots of travelling)

{npc:Tarun} wants to know where the Asuri go when they vanish from the {wiki:Asura Palace|Asura Palace}. You defeat three asuri princesses, put together the three parts of the {item:Asuri Talisman} and discover the island of {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}, where you help the nagas of the coast and the mountain: you heal the beavers, save the sage Timira, repair the observatory, organise the wedding of {npc:Candra} and {npc:Nihaka} and recover the stolen eggs. You gain access to Marapur, the {item:Colourful Water Lily} ({wiki:Giant Beaver (Mount)|Giant Beaver} mount), the {item:Lilypad Backpack}, the {item:Naga Nest} and the achievement **Wedding Planner**.
Part 1 (*Of Feathers and Flowers*): with the {item:Asuri Talisman}, the portal at the top of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains} (floor +5) takes you to Marapur.
*Coastal Concerns* part: {npc:Nilavarna} gives you the {item:Colourful Water Lily}, with which you can tame a Giant Beaver.
